author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
Hello,

Recently I have been trying to add as many maps as I can but when mapdevs don't get stuff on time or put it in even the correct MD#, we get yelled at through in-game, skype, and a case has happened in teamspeak where I was personally yelled at. I wish for this to not happen anymore and I apologize for the neglected 2 pages of maps that I have not exactly been able to review. Especially to lesser-known authors, I'm sorry I have been paying more attention to the more constant mapmakers. This will hopefully change, but once you are in a rut it's sometimes difficult to get out of. If you have a map and want me to review it, please post it here. I seemed to have cleared my alerts and any support helps.
